Attune 0.0.2 brings a refreshed macOS look and a simpler first launch.

- Refreshes the app icon for light and dark appearances and adapts the Dock icon to the active appearance.
- Adds a macOS disk image with a visual drag-to-Applications installation flow and an animated star trail. ZIP packages remain available for in-app updates.
- Updates the README with Gatekeeper steps for the current ad-hoc-signed, not notarized macOS downloads.

USB Kindle support remains experimental across macOS, Linux, and Windows; physical-device behavior has not been validated on every platform. See INSTALL.txt for platform requirements and signing status.
